title: Information Exchange Meeting Held with Private Companies and Organizations to Advance Dementia-Friendly Barrier-Free Society
summary: Niigata Prefecture hosted an information exchange meeting with private companies and organizations to promote the realization of a dementia-friendly barrier-free society.
body:
Niigata Prefecture hosted an information exchange meeting with private companies and organizations to promote the realization of a dementia-friendly barrier-free society.

title: Urban Park Green Spaces Accessibility Environment Supervision Review Earns Second 'Excellent' Rating for Town-Type Category
summary: The supervision and review of accessibility environments in urban park green spaces have again earned an 'excellent' rating in the town-type category, marking the second consecutive achievement.
body:
The supervision and review of accessibility environments in urban park green spaces have again earned an 'excellent' rating in the town-type category, marking the second consecutive achievement.
